transcript.text: I have a serious concern. I checked the distributor portal this morning, and the current KDM is authorized only for Hall B's secure projector — not Hall A. It also includes a no-camera-capture condition that applies to both the screening and the Q&A. This update came in after the technical run sheet was circulated, so the draft still has us in Hall A with Q&A recording enabled, which would violate the distributor's terms.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical safety and insurance issue. I received the signed fire-marshal certificate after the morning operations meeting and haven't attached it to the venue file yet. The certificate caps Hall B at exactly 140 audience members because one exit is under repair. Additionally, the insurer requires a filed crowd-flow plan specifying one-way entry before admission. So if we're now considering moving the screening to Hall B as Leila's KDM issue suggests, we cannot keep the draft's 180 audience capacity — we'd need to reduce to 140 and file that one-way entry crowd-flow plan with the insurer before anyone is admitted.
